_comment: HAND-DERIVED AS3 semantics for every case in GetFmtCases.as, cross-checked against adl 51.4.1 (g21-gettextformat-air.txt, 30/30). None of these are copied from our own AOT output: the rule below is what the AIR reference actually does, measured before the fix.
_derivation: getTextFormat(begin,end) answers with the TextFormat IN EFFECT over [begin,end). The answer is a single format only when every character of the range carries the same format (the covering run, or defaultTextFormat in a gap): no runs at all -> defaultTextFormat (20/black); inside one run -> that run (30/0xFF0000 or 44/0x00FF00); two ADJACENT runs with identical numbers -> that format (case 27). A range that straddles a change (5,9,10,11,12), a reversed range (16) or an EMPTY range (3,21,29,30) answers an EMPTY TextFormat whose fields are all null. Out-of-bounds throws RangeError #2006 -- begin>=length (4,15), end>length (24), empty text with explicit indices (18,19) -- and (0,0) throws too while (3,3) does not; a -1 bound means 'not supplied' and is never bounds-checked, so (-1,-1) on empty text answers empty (14) and (-1,5)/(5,-1) answer the default (25,26).

label.4: no runs, empty range at the end (10,10)
label.9: one run [2,6), range spans INTO the run
label.10: one run [2,6), range spans OUT of the run
label.11: one run [2,6), range covers run + both sides
label.13: two different runs, inside the second
label.21: one run, empty range at its start (2,2)
label.27: two runs with the SAME values
label.28: one run covering everything, no args
label.29: one run, empty range at its end (6,6)
label.30: one run, empty range before it (1,1)
